body.name: Froststone Ingot
body.description: A highly enriched ingot of pure Froststone, it maintains an unyielding cold even in the fiercest heat.

body.name: Froststone Ore
body.description: A chunk of raw material that pulses with the eternal cold of the frozen abyss.

body.name: Froststone Powder
body.description: Powder made by finely grinding Froststone ore.

body.name: Frost Wyvern's Claws
body.description: These razor-sharp talons, forged from glacial ice, are as formidable as the beasts that wield them.

body.name: Frost Wyvern Egg
body.description: Mystical egg, cool to the touch, encapsulating the delicate balance of fragility and resilience.

body.name: Frost Wyvern's Hide
body.description: A dense, frost-encrusted layer torn from the icy beast's form. It gleams with the frozen essence of the abyss, a testament to the Wyvern's mastery over the icy expanse.

body.name: Frostbitten Mallet
body.description: A hammer forged from the essence of cold gathered from the monsters of Frost Mountain. It is the only weapon capable of shattering the sealed wyvern statue, which no ordinary weapon can break. Once the statue is destroyed, the Frost Wyvern will awaken.

body.name: Frosted Feather
body.description: This feather, taken from the Ice Harpy’s wings and covered in an eternal layer of frost, embodies the icy spirit of its frigid realm.

body.name: Frostlight Abyss Plate Armor
body.description: A striking set of plate armor forged from a rare ore that pulses with eternal frost, providing both a stalwart defense and an intimidating presence.

body.name: Frostlight Aketon
body.description: A quilted armor pulsing with the cold of the frozen abyss, offering flexible protection that adapts to the wearer's movements.

body.name: Frostlight Cloak
body.description: Crafted from fabrics touched by the eternal chill, this cloak offers a serene yet powerful presence, echoing the quiet strength of ancient ice.

body.name: Frostlight Crusader Helm
body.description: An imposing crusader helm crafted from Froststone Ingots, intertwining the chilling touch of the frozen abyss with the enduring might of the noble and the devout.

body.name: Frostlight Crystal Sword
body.description: Skillfully crafted and imbued with the enduring cold of Froststone, this crystal sword seamlessly integrates magic, transforming into an adept vessel for arcane power.

body.name: Frostlight Feathered Hat
body.description: A charming hat infused with Froststone Powder, merging the perpetual frost of the frozen abyss with the quick-witted finesse of the nimble and clever.

body.name: Frostlight Gauntlets
body.description: Forged from mystical Froststone, these gauntlets meld the biting chill of eternal ice with a rugged, battle-ready construction.

body.name: Frostlight Hood
body.description: A sleek hood crafted from Froststone Powder, intertwining the frigid touch of the frozen abyss with dark allure.

body.name: Frostlight Lantern Shield
body.description: This shield emanates an everlasting cold that remains steadfast even in the most intense environments. Its retractable blade and lantern offer invaluable support for combat and exploration.

body.name: Frostlight Leather Leggings
body.description: Crafted from reinforced leather and suffused with timeless cold, these leggings offer agile movement with the glacial strength of the abyss.

body.name: Frostlight Lightfoot Boots
body.description: Light and durable, these leather boots are imbued with the arcane resilience of froststone, ensuring swift movement through diverse challenges.

body.name: Frostlight Mystic Gloves
body.description: Exquisitely crafted and intricately designed, these gloves draw from the frozen abyss, allowing spellcasters to wield their magic with finesse.
